cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Here We Go Again
cards.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This time my battery died.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're cancelling Sunday again? Mum's already made up the spare bed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Work changed my shift. I can't help it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was overtime. Same empty bed, same explanation from me. You tell her this time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll think I don't want to visit. Could you soften it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the pattern: you cancel, I soften. Now you can arrange the next visit with her too.

cards.title: Let Me Lean
cards.instruction: Get someone to carry part of the emotional burden without making you name how heavy it has become.

beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could you cancel our anniversary table? The restaurant number's on the fridge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What's happened?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Please let the call be the first thing you take off me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call. They might ask whether you want another date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say no for me. Then stay while I put the anniversary glasses away. You can tell me about your day.

cards.title: Stay Until I’m Steady
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until you feel steady enough to face what comes next without them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Stay for tea. I need to tell the children about tomorrow's operation without crying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've had three cups.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then skip the kettle. Let me practise telling you before I fetch them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My taxi's outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for two minutes. Let me say 'I'll be in hospital' without apologising to you. Then I'll try telling them myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you leave me in the new flat, count five breaths with me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That was five. Shall I close the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not yet. Five more while I look at the empty kitchen instead of you.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stay until it boils. Then I'll try pouring one cup without getting yours out.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I saved you a front-row seat at my concert. Do you understand why it hurt?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I knew. I still looked at that empty seat before every song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what this meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You'd heard me practise for months. Please tell me you understand why someone else couldn't fill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You looked so sure raising your paddle, I raised mine too. Lovely auction.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was bidding on that wardrobe. You've just outbid me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. I always begin with storage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put your paddle down before you buy the matching bed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Let someone else make the beginner's mistake of buying a whole bedroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my shoes beside yours for the interview. Very forward-thinking firm.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine are off because the heel broke.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. I prefer a preventative approach.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then put yours back on. The interviewer is coming.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Shoes off for reception, on for the interview. Very clear progression.

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I texted that I'd lost my job. You replied, 'What's for dinner?'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought something normal would help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Making your dinner? Can you see why I felt like the cook?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I meant we could go out. I'll book somewhere.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believe you. Before you book, can you see why I heard a chore? I needed you to ask how I was.

beats.text: I'll spread mine out. Nobody will notice the gap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I need to know I've contributed, not that you can hide where I haven't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yours belongs in the middle. It's the one people will see first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then introduce me as the other painter. No 'despite everything'. I want to hear that I belong here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I made it through the speech without leaving. Was that enough?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You forgot a paragraph.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'm asking about staying.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You stayed all the way through. I'll help you practise the missing bit tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could staying earn me tomorrow off? Tell me I can put the speech away.
